question.text: For a Cat III AIF treating income as 'Profits or Gains from Business or Profession', the tax is paid by:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 10(23FBA)/(23FBB), business income of Cat III AIFs is taxed at the fund level; 'other' income typically flows to investors. The Trap: Unit holder/trustee-level taxation on business income isn't how Cat III operates. Cross-Exam Context: Drives the fund-level vs investor-level distinction. Distributor's Pro-Tip: This drives the 'double-layer' tax perception for Cat III — build into pricing.
